terms.gloss: censor (the Roman magistrate; also a stern critic)
terms.comment: The Roman magistrate who took the census and watched over morals; hence any severe judge of conduct.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 178, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
